title: Member Repair Pricing Benefits of the HVAC Maintenance Agreements
content:
Member repair pricing figures for HVAC Maintenance Agreements, applying to repairs the member pays for that are carried out by network HVAC contractors.

| Agreement level | Member repair discount rate | Maximum member discount on one repair invoice (USD) | After-hours overtime charges waived | Member repair call scheduled within (hours) | Member diagnostic fee (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bridgewell Comfort Care Essential | 10% (0.10) | 250.00 | No | 72 | 89.00 |
| Bridgewell Comfort Care Standard | 10% (0.10) | 300.00 | Yes | 48 | 79.00 |
| Bridgewell Comfort Care Plus | 15% (0.15) | 400.00 | Yes | 48 | 0.00 |
| Bridgewell Comfort Care Dual-System | 10% (0.10) | 300.00 | Yes | 48 | 79.00 |
| Bridgewell Comfort Care Dual-System Plus | 15% (0.15) | 400.00 | Yes | 24 | 0.00 |
| Bridgewell Comfort Care Premier | 20% (0.20) | 600.00 | Yes | 24 | 0.00 |

## Definitions

- **Member repair discount rate**: the member discount on customer-paid repairs by network HVAC contractors, stated as a decimal fraction.
- **Maximum member discount on one repair invoice**: the largest member discount allowed on a single repair invoice, in US dollars.
- **After-hours overtime charges waived**: whether after-hours overtime charges are waived on member repairs.
- **Scheduled within**: the number of hours within which a member repair call is scheduled.
- **Member diagnostic fee**: the diagnostic fee a member pays on a repair call, in US dollars.

## Comparing the levels

- Bridgewell Comfort Care Essential is the only level on which overtime charges are not waived; it also has the longest scheduling window, 72 hours, and the highest member diagnostic fee, 89.00.
- Bridgewell Comfort Care Plus, Dual-System Plus and Premier carry a member diagnostic fee of 0.00.
- Standard and Dual-System share the same repair figures: a 10% rate, a 300.00 maximum per invoice, a 48-hour scheduling window and a 79.00 diagnostic fee.
- Premier has the highest rate, 20%, and the highest maximum per invoice, 600.00.

## Schedule questions

**What is the largest discount a Bridgewell Comfort Care Plus member can receive on one repair invoice?** 400.00.

**Within how many hours is a Bridgewell Comfort Care Dual-System Plus member repair call scheduled?** Within 24 hours.
